data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: architectural-probe.md agent contains no 'self-use' or 'topology' language; brainstorm SKILL.md dispatches the probe for class:architectural epics (lines 166-176) without requiring the probe to answer 'Can this epic's own sprint run on the architecture it delivers? If not, what is the bootstrap gap?' Proposed fix: (a) add a self-use criterion question to plugins/dso/agents/architectural-probe.md; (b) optionally add a trigger condition in the brainstorm dispatch block when the epic touches sprint SKILL.md, debug-everything SKILL.md, or .github/workflows/*.yml relied on by sprint. Classification: MODERATE — two instruction-file edits with a clear behavioral test (a fixture epic touching sprint SKILL.md must produce probe output containing the self-use answer). Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
